instructions.primary_message: Preheat oven to 375°F. Line a large baking sheet pan with parchment paper. Coat the paper with a thin layer oil and set aside.
Place spinach in a colander and rinse under hot, running water (from the tap) to defrost; set aside to drain further.
Place butter in a small saucepan and set over medium-low heat to melt. Once melted, transfer to a medium bowl.
Add eggs and spices to the bowl with the melted butter. Whisk to combine.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 tsp onion powder
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp garlic powder
¼ tsp black pepper
⅛ tsp crushed red pepper

instructions.primary_message: Using your hands, squeeze as much water from the spinach as you can.

Add spinach, bread crumbs, and cheese to the bowl, then stir to combine. Using a generous tablespoon measure, shape the spinach mixture into 1-inch balls and arrange on the baking sheet, spacing them about 2 inches apart.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 cup panko bread crumbs
1 cup Parmesan cheese, shredded

instructions.primary_message: Place baking sheet in the oven and bake until spinach bites are golden and cooked through, 15-18 minutes. Remove from oven.
Transfer spinach bites to a platter and serve warm or at room temperature. Enjoy!
